items.title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
items.summary: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.

items.title: Malaysia's disgraced former PM leaves jail for house arrest after embezzling millions
items.summary: Najib Razak was convicted for his role in the billion-dollar scandal involving the 1MDB sovereign wealth fund.

items.title: Israel's new parliament sworn in as leaders compete to form government
items.summary: Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, has first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.

items.title: Violence erupts in Bangladesh as ousted PM's supporters stage protest
items.summary: Supporters of Sheikh Hasina want her to return from exile in India.

items.title: Spain's king and queen attend memorial service for rail crash victims
items.summary: Sixty-nine people died in the collision near Toledo two weeks ago and 28 are still in hospital.

items.title: Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned
items.summary: The ruling brings to an end an 11-year legal battle by dual-citizen Jason Jones.
